events.notes: Viewed native sheets0/1 (figures0-7),including both raw/EMA mesh triplets and40x boards. Seed2302 remains nearly blank at ordinary display and broad mottling replaces most crossed detail at40x. Seed2309 retains one dominant diagonal family while GT crossing strands remain weak/missing. V172 resembles V169 and does not show a clear visual recovery of the missing crossings;periodic comparator is stronger but distorted.

Viewed sheets2/3 (figures8-15): absent-field40x mottle persists, main sky looks smooth at ordinary exposure, building/foliage/coarse fence remain near V169 and softened against independently demosaiced ISO100. Fine cab nominal windows and first profile window still lose most crossed strands;one diagonal texture family remains. V172 is visually near V169 without a clear new sky pattern;this limited view is not a flat-safety guarantee. Both JPEGs and differing-aperture ISO100 are qualitative only.

Viewed sheets4/5 (figures16-23). Second cab profile window retains diagonal smears/weak crosses similar to V169,far from ISO100 fine lattice. Organic faint bird and dark insect/feather/foliage controls remain strongly smoothed relative to constructed targets,with little visible change among V169/V172. ADC flats remain visually uniform and identical in new methods;noisy standalone gray/ISO12800 and512 ISO6400 retain broad colored mottle. V172 flat difference is subtle and V171 sometimes looks a little smoother.

Viewed sheets6/7 (figures24-31),including ISO6400/12800 raw and EMA native flat triplets. V172 retains colored coarse mottle and grain against the truly uniform GT;difference from V169 is slight. V171 flat smoothing is not carried over strongly. The blue-tinted flat and brighter gray/nearwhite controls also retain broad variation;no claim of hallucination-free noisy flats follows.

Viewed sheets8/9 (figures32-39): faint/dark retained bird/branch controls remain similarly blurred. Mixed quiet ISO6400 raw/EMA boards/triplets and ISO12800 board/raw triplet clearly remove much of V171 added purple/blue cast,returning close to V169 color. They still contain strong broad colored mottle and fine residual texture against the uniform quiet GT. Whole-step context retains sharp main boundary and unchanged broad levels;small numerical quiet gains over V169 are not a dramatic visual cleanup.

Viewed sheets10/11 (figures40-47),including ISO12800 EMA quiet triplet,whole-step controls and narrow-bar/slanted-step windows. Strong green/purple broad mottle remains versus exact uniform quiet GT. Slanted-step ISO6400 again loses much of V171 purple/blue bias and returns near V169;the narrow-bar windows have smaller color changes. Whole-context edges remain crisp while displayed quiet residuals are structured. This is correction of a V171 color regression,not clean flat recovery.

Viewed sheets12/13 (figures48-55). Slanted-step and striped-patch quiet residuals keep broad chromatic structure;V172 reduces the additional V171 cast but returns mainly to V169 appearance. Constructed bright striped detail remains crisp at whole-context display. ADC bark/fur controls retain V169 identically and do not acquire the external V170 periodic texture;baseline ADC fur and fine bark still differ from constructed GT.

Viewed sheet14 (figures56-59),all four ADC sloped planes at their fixed displays. V172 endpoints preserve the baseline values and smooth appearance without new periodic texture;small inherited deviations from exact constructed planes remain. All15 sheets/60 figures,including12 native triplets,were actually viewed at original detail.
